scope: Recorded CPU outputs and finite fixtures. Browser selections never run Python or a language model.

lifecycle.scope:
One bounded random-model lifecycle preflight, no timing benchmark.

Three queued requests: two finite completions and one cancellation before start.
At most three useful output tokens; no warmup or pretrained model invocation.
The cancellation API is not assumed to emit a terminal GenerationOutput.
checks: Initialization and empty unstarted retrieval perform no forward.
Exact request identity, finite caps and recorded terminal timestamps pass.
Canceled pending request removed without a GenerationOutput; queues drain; no warmup.
Blocking stop ends thread and clears processor; destroy is idempotent.
